_info.description:
P2b (block 1) + R7a-2 reset (block 2) + R8a-1 (block 3).

    One authority, Alice, through two full delegate -> selfdestruct ->
    reset rounds. Block 1 delegates Alice to oracle1 (SELFDESTRUCT to
    B1) and sweeps her 100 to B1; Alice survives. Block 2 resets the
    delegation and funds Alice with 100 (the reset tx is addressed to
    Alice: the auth clears her code before the call, so the value
    stays). Block 3 delegates Alice again (to oracle3, SELFDESTRUCT
    to fresh B3), sweeps the 100 to B3, resets, and a trailing CALL
    must be a 15,000 no-op. A client that caches the delegation across
    the block-2 reset would charge 31,816 (not 67,006) for the
    block-3 delegation; a client that reuses the beneficiary would
    charge 35,003 (not 218,603) for the block-3 sweep.
